_README: Add features here for determinations the auto-run flagged in needs_review.txt (letters whose table is an IMAGE, or a non-PDF letter). Open the DataViewer link from needs_review.txt, read the table, and copy each Stream/WWC feature below. The pipeline merges these on every run. Only include Streams and Wet Weather Conveyances (skip wetlands, ponds, upland points). 'point': true means the letter gave a single coordinate (set start and end the same).
